newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via 5-day system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via 5-day system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to inject reserves into the banking system using five-day system repurchase agreements on Thursday, market sources said.
The Fed will probably commence the new two-week maintenance period on Thursday with an operation which covers the Memorial Day holiday weekend, they said.
Analysts speculate the Fed faces an average daily add need of $5 billion to $7 billion during the first half of the period.
With the add need growing in coming weeks, analysts said a permanent injection of reserves could come any time during this period, via an outright purchase of bills or, less likely, a coupon pass.
The Fed has performed a bill pass within two weeks after Memorial Day for six of the last seven years, though the add need this year is not so large as to make one a sure bet, analsyst said.
The federal funds rate was trading at its 5-1/2 percent target rate early Thursday.
